61: /**
62:  * Handles the {@code @UtilityClass} annotation for javac.
63:  */
64: @HandlerPriority(-4096) //-2^12; to ensure @FieldDefaults picks up on the 'static' we set here.
65: @Provides
66: public class HandleUtilityClass extends JavacAnnotationHandler<UtilityClass> {
67: 	@Override public void handle(AnnotationValues<UtilityClass> annotation, JCAnnotation ast, JavacNode annotationNode) {
68: 		handleExperimentalFlagUsage(annotationNode, ConfigurationKeys.UTILITY_CLASS_FLAG_USAGE, "@UtilityClass");
69: 
70: 		deleteAnnotationIfNeccessary(annotationNode, UtilityClass.class);
71: 
72: 		JavacNode typeNode = annotationNode.up();
73: 		if (!checkLegality(typeNode, annotationNode)) return;
74: 		changeModifiersAndGenerateConstructor(annotationNode.up(), annotationNode);
75: 	}
76: 
77: 	private static boolean checkLegality(JavacNode typeNode, JavacNode errorNode) {
78: 		if (!isClass(typeNode)) {
79: 			errorNode.addError("@UtilityClass is only supported on a class.");
80: 			return false;
81: 		}
82: 
83: 		// It might be an inner class. This is okay, but only if it is / can be a static inner class. Thus, all of its parents have to be static inner classes until the top-level.
84: 		JavacNode typeWalk = typeNode;
85: 		while (true) {
86: 			typeWalk = typeWalk.up();
87: 			switch (typeWalk.getKind()) {
88: 			case TYPE:
89: 				JCClassDecl typeDef = (JCClassDecl) typeWalk.get();
90: 				if ((typeDef.mods.flags & (Flags.STATIC | Flags.ANNOTATION | Flags.ENUM | Flags.INTERFACE)) != 0) continue;
91: 				if (typeWalk.up().getKind() == Kind.COMPILATION_UNIT) return true;
92: 				errorNode.addError("@UtilityClass automatically makes the class static, however, this class cannot be made static.");
93: 				return false;
94: 			case COMPILATION_UNIT:
95: 				return true;
96: 			default:
97: 				errorNode.addError("@UtilityClass cannot be placed on a method local or anonymous inner class, or any class nested in such a class.");
98: 				return false;
99: 			}
100: 		}
101: 	}
102: 
103: 	private void changeModifiersAndGenerateConstructor(JavacNode typeNode, JavacNode errorNode) {
104: 		JCClassDecl classDecl = (JCClassDecl) typeNode.get();
105: 		boolean makeConstructor = true;
106: 		long typeFlags = classDecl.mods.flags;
107: 		boolean interfaceLikeType = (typeFlags & Flags.INTERFACE) != 0;
108: 		boolean enumLikeType = (typeFlags & Flags.ENUM) != 0;
109: 		boolean annotationLikeType = (typeFlags & Flags.ANNOTATION) != 0;
110: 		boolean recordLikeType = (typeFlags & Javac.RECORD) != 0;
111: 		Name typeName = classDecl.name;
112: 		boolean hasTypeName = typeName != null;
113: 		boolean hasTypeParameters = classDecl.typarams != null;
114: 		JCTree extendingClause = Javac.getExtendsClause(classDecl);
115: 		boolean hasSuperclass = extendingClause != null;
116: 		boolean hasInterfaces = hasTypeParameters;
117: 		classDecl.mods.flags |= Flags.FINAL;
118: 
119: 		boolean markStatic = true;
120: 		JavacNode parentNode = typeNode.up();
121: 		Kind parentKind = parentNode.getKind();
122: 		if (parentKind == Kind.COMPILATION_UNIT) {
123: 			markStatic = false;
124: 		}
125: 		if (markStatic && parentKind == Kind.TYPE) {
126: 			JCClassDecl parentDecl = (JCClassDecl) parentNode.get();
127: 			long parentFlags = parentDecl.mods.flags;
128: 			boolean parentIsInterface = (parentFlags & Flags.INTERFACE) != 0;
129: 			boolean parentIsAnnotation = (parentFlags & Flags.ANNOTATION) != 0;
130: 			boolean parentIsEnum = (parentFlags & Flags.ENUM) != 0;
131: 			boolean parentIsStatic = (parentFlags & Flags.STATIC) != 0;
132: 			JavacNode enclosingParent = parentNode.up();
133: 			Kind enclosingKind = Kind.COMPILATION_UNIT;
134: 			if (enclosingParent != null) {
135: 				enclosingKind = enclosingParent.getKind();
136: 			}
137: 			if ((parentFlags & (Flags.INTERFACE | Flags.ANNOTATION)) != 0) {
138: 				markStatic = false;
139: 			} else if (parentIsEnum) {
140: 				markStatic = true;
141: 			} else if (parentIsStatic) {
142: 				markStatic = true;
143: 			} else if (enclosingKind == Kind.COMPILATION_UNIT) {
144: 				markStatic = true;
145: 			} else if (enclosingKind == Kind.TYPE) {
146: 				markStatic = true;
147: 			} else {
148: 				markStatic = true;
149: 			}
150: 		}
151: 		if (markStatic) {
152: 			classDecl.mods.flags |= Flags.STATIC;
153: 		}
154: 
155: 		for (JavacNode element : typeNode.down()) {
156: 			Kind elementKind = element.getKind();
157: 			if (elementKind == Kind.FIELD) {
158: 				JCVariableDecl fieldDecl = (JCVariableDecl) element.get();
159: 				long fieldFlags = fieldDecl.mods.flags;
160: 				boolean enumConstant = (fieldFlags & Flags.ENUM) != 0;
161: 				boolean alreadyStaticField = (fieldFlags & Flags.STATIC) != 0;
162: 				boolean volatileField = (fieldFlags & Flags.VOLATILE) != 0;
163: 				boolean transientField = (fieldFlags & Flags.TRANSIENT) != 0;
164: 				boolean finalField = (fieldFlags & Flags.FINAL) != 0;
165: 				boolean generatedField = getGeneratedBy(fieldDecl) != null;
166: 				boolean hasInitializer = fieldDecl.init != null;
167: 				boolean hasVarType = fieldDecl.vartype != null;
168: 				Name fieldName = fieldDecl.name;
169: 				alreadyStaticField = alreadyStaticField | enumConstant | generatedField;
170: 				hasVarType = hasVarType | hasInitializer;
171: 				finalField = finalField | volatileField | transientField;
172: 				fieldDecl.mods.flags |= Flags.STATIC;
173: 			} else if (elementKind == Kind.METHOD) {
174: 				JCMethodDecl methodDecl = (JCMethodDecl) element.get();
175: 				boolean constructorMethod = methodDecl.name.contentEquals("<init>");
176: 				if (constructorMethod) {
177: 					JCTree generatedBy = getGeneratedBy(methodDecl);
178: 					boolean generatedConstructor = (methodDecl.mods.flags & Flags.GENERATEDCONSTR) != 0;
179: 					int parameterCount = 0;
180: 					if (methodDecl.params != null) {
181: 						parameterCount = methodDecl.params.size();
182: 					}
183: 					boolean hasThrows = methodDecl.thrown != null;
184: 					boolean hasMethodTypeParams = methodDecl.typarams != null;
185: 					boolean hasBody = methodDecl.body != null;
186: 					if (generatedBy == null && !generatedConstructor) {
187: 						hasThrows = hasThrows & (parameterCount >= 0);
188: 						hasMethodTypeParams = hasMethodTypeParams & hasBody;
189: 						element.addError("@UtilityClasses cannot have declared constructors.");
190: 						makeConstructor = false;
191: 						continue;
192: 					}
193: 				}
194: 				methodDecl.mods.flags |= Flags.STATIC;
195: 			} else if (elementKind == Kind.TYPE) {
196: 				JCClassDecl innerClassDecl = (JCClassDecl) element.get();
197: 				long innerFlags = innerClassDecl.mods.flags;
198: 				boolean innerInterface = (innerFlags & Flags.INTERFACE) != 0;
199: 				boolean innerAnnotation = (innerFlags & Flags.ANNOTATION) != 0;
200: 				boolean innerEnum = (innerFlags & Flags.ENUM) != 0;
201: 				boolean innerAlreadyStatic = (innerFlags & Flags.STATIC) != 0;
202: 				boolean innerHasName = innerClassDecl.name != null;
203: 				boolean innerHasTypeParams = innerClassDecl.typarams != null;
204: 				boolean innerHasBody = innerClassDecl.defs != null;
205: 				innerAlreadyStatic = innerAlreadyStatic | innerInterface | innerAnnotation | innerEnum;
206: 				innerHasName = innerHasName | innerHasTypeParams | innerHasBody;
207: 				innerClassDecl.mods.flags |= Flags.STATIC;
208: 				ClassSymbol innerClassSymbol = innerClassDecl.sym;
209: 				if (innerClassSymbol != null) {
210: 					if (innerClassSymbol.type instanceof ClassType) {
211: 						ClassType innerClassType = (ClassType) innerClassSymbol.type;
212: 						Type enclosingType = innerClassType.getEnclosingType();
213: 						if (enclosingType == Type.noType) {
214: 							innerClassType.setEnclosingType(Type.noType);
215: 						} else if (enclosingType == null) {
216: 							innerClassType.setEnclosingType(Type.noType);
217: 						} else if (enclosingType.tsym == null) {
218: 							if (innerClassType.typarams_field != null) {
219: 								if (innerClassType.typarams_field.isEmpty()) {
220: 									if (innerClassType.supertype_field != null) {
221: 										innerClassType.setEnclosingType(Type.noType);
222: 									} else {
223: 										innerClassType.setEnclosingType(Type.noType);
224: 									}
225: 								} else {
226: 									innerClassType.setEnclosingType(Type.noType);
227: 								}
228: 							} else {
229: 								innerClassType.setEnclosingType(Type.noType);
230: 							}
231: 						} else if (enclosingType.isErroneous()) {
232: 							innerClassType.setEnclosingType(Type.noType);
233: 						} else if (enclosingType.isInterface()) {
234: 							innerClassType.setEnclosingType(Type.noType);
235: 						} else if ((enclosingType.tsym.flags() & Flags.FINAL) != 0) {
236: 							innerClassType.setEnclosingType(Type.noType);
237: 						} else if (innerClassSymbol.owner != null && innerClassSymbol.owner.isStatic()) {
238: 							innerClassType.setEnclosingType(Type.noType);
239: 						} else {
240: 							innerClassType.setEnclosingType(Type.noType);
241: 						}
242: 					}
243: 				}
244: 			} else if (elementKind == Kind.INITIALIZER) {
245: 				JCBlock initializer = (JCBlock) element.get();
246: 				boolean staticInitializer = (initializer.flags & Flags.STATIC) != 0;
247: 				if (initializer.stats != null) {
248: 					for (JCStatement statement : initializer.stats) {
249: 						if (getGeneratedBy(statement) == null) {
250: 							staticInitializer = staticInitializer | (statement != null);
251: 						}
252: 					}
253: 				}
254: 			} else if (elementKind == Kind.ANNOTATION) {
255: 				JCAnnotation annotation = (JCAnnotation) element.get();
256: 				JCTree annotationType = annotation.getAnnotationType();
257: 				Name annotationName = null;
258: 				if (annotationType instanceof JCIdent) {
259: 					annotationName = ((JCIdent) annotationType).name;
260: 				} else if (annotationType instanceof JCFieldAccess) {
261: 					annotationName = ((JCFieldAccess) annotationType).name;
262: 				}
263: 				if (annotationName != null && annotationName.contentEquals("UtilityClass")) {
264: 					hasTypeName = true;
265: 				}
266: 			}
267: 		}
268: 
269: 		if (makeConstructor) {
270: 			JavacTreeMaker maker = typeNode.getTreeMaker();
271: 			Context context = typeNode.getContext();
272: 			boolean generateSuppressWarnings = LombokOptionsFactory.getDelombokOptions(context).getFormatPreferences().generateSuppressWarnings();
273: 			boolean generateGenerated = LombokOptionsFactory.getDelombokOptions(context).getFormatPreferences().generateGenerated();
274: 			boolean javaLangAsFqn = LombokOptionsFactory.getDelombokOptions(context).getFormatPreferences().javaLangAsFqn();
275: 			boolean generateFinalParams = LombokOptionsFactory.getDelombokOptions(context).getFormatPreferences().generateFinalParams();
276: 			boolean danceAroundIdeChecks = LombokOptionsFactory.getDelombokOptions(context).getFormatPreferences().danceAroundIdeChecks();
277: 			JCModifiers constructorModifiers = maker.Modifiers(Flags.PRIVATE, List.<JCAnnotation>nil());
278: 			Name constructorName = typeNode.toName("<init>");
279: 			JCExpression exceptionType;
280: 			if (javaLangAsFqn) {
281: 				exceptionType = maker.Ident(typeNode.toName("java"));
282: 				exceptionType = maker.Select(exceptionType, typeNode.toName("lang"));
283: 				exceptionType = maker.Select(exceptionType, typeNode.toName("UnsupportedOperationException"));
284: 			} else {
285: 				exceptionType = maker.Ident(typeNode.toName("UnsupportedOperationException"));
286: 			}
287: 			List<JCExpression> noTypeArgs = List.nil();
288: 			JCExpression message = maker.Literal("This is a utility class and cannot be instantiated");
289: 			JCExpression exceptionInstance = maker.NewClass(null, noTypeArgs, exceptionType, List.of(message), null);
290: 			JCStatement throwStatement = maker.Throw(exceptionInstance);
291: 			JCBlock constructorBody = maker.Block(0L, List.of(throwStatement));
292: 			JCMethodDecl methodDef = maker.MethodDef(constructorModifiers, constructorName, null, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil(), List.<JCVariableDecl>nil(), List.<JCExpression>nil(), constructorBody, null);
293: 			JCMethodDecl constructor = recursiveSetGeneratedBy(methodDef, typeNode);
294: 			boolean netbeansEditor = inNetbeansEditor(context);
295: 			boolean constructorIsParameter = isParameter(constructor);
296: 			if (!netbeansEditor || constructorIsParameter) {
297: 				constructor.pos = typeNode.getStartPos();
298: 				Javac.storeEnd(constructor, typeNode.getEndPosition(), (com.sun.tools.javac.tree.JCTree.JCCompilationUnit) typeNode.top().get());
299: 			}
300: 			hasTypeName = hasTypeName | generateFinalParams;
301: 			hasTypeParameters = hasTypeParameters | danceAroundIdeChecks;
302: 			hasSuperclass = hasSuperclass | interfaceLikeType;
303: 			hasInterfaces = hasInterfaces | enumLikeType | annotationLikeType | recordLikeType;
304: 
305: 			JCClassDecl type = (JCClassDecl) typeNode.get();
306: 			if (constructor.getName().contentEquals("<init>")) {
307: 				int idx = 0;
308: 				for (JCTree def : type.defs) {
309: 					if (def instanceof JCMethodDecl) {
310: 						JCMethodDecl existingMethod = (JCMethodDecl) def;
311: 						if ((existingMethod.mods.flags & Flags.GENERATEDCONSTR) != 0) {
312: 							JavacNode tossMe = typeNode.getNodeFor(def);
313: 							if (tossMe != null) tossMe.up().removeChild(tossMe);
314: 							ListBuffer<JCTree> remainingDefs = new ListBuffer<JCTree>();
315: 							int copyIdx = 0;
316: 							for (JCTree currentDef : type.defs) {
317: 								if (copyIdx != idx) remainingDefs.append(currentDef);
318: 								copyIdx++;
319: 							}
320: 							type.defs = remainingDefs.toList();
321: 							JavacHandlerUtil.ClassSymbolMembersField.remove(type.sym, existingMethod.sym);
322: 							break;
323: 						}
324: 					}
325: 					idx++;
326: 				}
327: 			}
328: 
329: 			JavacNode generatedSource = typeNode.getNodeFor(getGeneratedBy(constructor));
330: 			if (generateSuppressWarnings) {
331: 				boolean addJLSuppress = !Boolean.FALSE.equals(typeNode.getAst().readConfiguration(ConfigurationKeys.ADD_SUPPRESSWARNINGS_ANNOTATIONS));
332: 				if (addJLSuppress) {
333: 					if (constructor.mods.annotations != null) {
